name: OmarMK
author: Comm4nd0
description: Keeps an eye on a Checkmk monitoring site from the bar: a count of hosts and services with problems, a popup listing them worst first, and a desktop notification the moment something new goes WARN, CRIT or DOWN, with a button that asks your Omarchy AI agent to investigate and fix them.

barWidget.description: Checkmk problems at a glance, with notifications.

schema.label: Checkmk site URL
schema.description: The site root, for example http://checkmk.lan/mysite (what you see in the browser before /check_mk/).

schema.label: Automation username
schema.description: A Checkmk automation user. A read-only one (role Guest user) is all this widget needs.

schema.label: Secret file
schema.description: File holding the automation user's secret, readable only by you (chmod 600). The secret is never stored in shell.json.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify when a host or service newly enters a problem state or gets worse. The first check after login sends one summary.

schema.label: Notify from
schema.description: Lowest state that triggers a notification. Down hosts always count as critical.

schema.label: Only hard states
schema.description: Ignore soft states that Checkmk is still re-checking, the same way its own notifications do.

schema.label: Accept self-signed HTTPS
schema.description: Skip certificate verification for a site with a self-signed certificate.

schema.label: Ask the AI agent to fix
schema.description: Show buttons that hand problems to Omarchy's default coding agent (omarchy agent) in a terminal.

schema.label: Let the agent apply safe fixes
schema.description: Off: the agent diagnoses and asks before changing anything. On: it may apply safe, reversible fixes itself and asks only before destructive ones.

schema.label: Notes for the agent
schema.description: Added to every prompt, for example how to reach your machines: "SSH as root to each host by name; Proxmox containers run on pve1 and pve2."
